contents.name: kind
contents.description: Which block kind — drives the renderer (one of the ten kinds).

contents.name: title
contents.description: Block heading.

contents.name: time
contents.description: Optional time-of-day label, e.g. '08:30'.

contents.name: description
contents.description: Markdown body of the block.

contents.name: links
contents.description: External links attached to the block.

contents.name: cost
contents.description: Monetary cost (number; pair with `currency`).

contents.name: currency
contents.description: ISO currency code for `cost`, e.g. 'CAD'.

contents.name: status
contents.description: Lifecycle: planned | booked | done.

contents.name: bookingCode
contents.description: Confirmation / booking reference.

contents.name: order
contents.description: Sort order within the day (0-based).

contents.name: items
contents.description: todo → [{label,done}] · gallery → [bare media filenames] · custom → raw (sanitized) html.

contents.name: html
contents.description: Raw HTML for `custom` blocks (client-sanitized).

contents.name: distance
contents.description: Drive distance, e.g. '143 km' (transport blocks).

contents.name: duration
contents.description: Drive duration, e.g. '1 h 35' (transport blocks).

contents.name: route
contents.description: Route name, e.g. 'Hwy 1 West, via Canmore'.

contents.name: via
contents.description: Notable waypoints, e.g. 'Rogers Pass (Glacier NP)'.

contents.name: from
contents.description: Directions origin place name/alias.

contents.name: to
contents.description: Directions destination place name/alias.

contents.name: mode
contents.description: Explicit transport mode: flight | drive | train | ferry (beats the heuristic).

contents.name: location
contents.description: Place name/alias → auto Google Maps link + map thumbnail.

contents.name: mapsQuery
contents.description: Precise query for the ACTUAL place (hotel/restaurant) — overrides `location` for the link + thumbnail pin.

contents.name: googlePlaceId
contents.description: Google place_id for THE specific venue (hotel/restaurant, not just the town) — preferred deep-link key for the Google Maps link (keyless URL form, no photo/review fetch). Indefinitely cacheable per the #15/#95 storage rule.

contents.name: images
contents.description: Card media strip — bare media filenames, served by the API at /media/<trip_id>/<file>.

contents.name: atLocation
contents.description: Synthesized by the converter (not a model field) — links this Block to its Location twin(s).

description: One coarse content block. `kind` selects the renderer; shared fields cover

contents.name: date
contents.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

contents.name: title
contents.description: Day heading.

contents.name: notes
contents.description: Markdown day-level notes.

contents.name: map
contents.description: Optional map image for this day — bare media filename, served at /media/<trip_id>/<file>.

contents.name: meta
contents.description: Stay/Lift/Flight chips (label/value).

contents.name: hasBlock
contents.description: Links this Day to its Block twin(s) (from `blocks`).

description: A single dated day in the itinerary; owns its ordered blocks.

contents.name: kicker
contents.description: Small overline above the title.

contents.name: title
contents.description: Feature title.

contents.name: description
contents.description: Feature body (markdown).

contents.name: image
contents.description: Hero image — bare media filename, served at /media/<trip_id>/<file>.

contents.name: images
contents.description: 2-column image layout (centerpiece) — bare media filenames, served at /media/<trip_id>/<file>.

contents.name: chips
contents.description: Highlight chips (centerpiece).

contents.name: cards
contents.description: Resort/route card grid.

contents.name: map
contents.description: Render the trip's dynamic map here (JS web / static print).

contents.name: links
contents.description: Feature-level links.

description: An editorial overview card (booklet 'centerpiece' / 'road trip' sections).
P2 per-trip live feed entry (type, payload, visibility).

contents.name: type
contents.description: Entry type, e.g. 'photo' | 'note' | 'activity'.

contents.name: payload
contents.description: Entry payload (serialized JSON or markdown).

contents.name: visibility
contents.description: Who can see it: public | crew | followers | private.

description: P2 external integration (photos|strava|timeline|steps). Token lives in app secrets, never in the graph (spec §5).

contents.name: kind
contents.description: Integration kind: photos | strava | timeline | steps.

contents.name: status
contents.description: Connection status (e.g. active | paused | error).

contents.name: tokenRef
contents.description: Reference to the OAuth token in the app secret store (never stored in the graph).

contents.name: name
contents.description: Place name (the canonical key).

contents.name: marker
contents.description: Explicit ① ② … loop-marker number; defaults to 1-based position in trip.locations.

contents.name: alias
contents.description: Alternate names that resolve to this location, e.g. 'Hillcrest' → Revelstoke.

contents.name: lat
contents.description: Latitude (enables map generation).

contents.name: lng
contents.description: Longitude (enables map generation).

contents.name: placeId
contents.description: Google place_id — the only third-party place key that may be persisted indefinitely (#15 storage rule). Drives the keyless Google Maps deep link.

contents.name: address
contents.description: Formatted display address, e.g. '1-1 Niseko Hirafu…'.

contents.name: website
contents.description: Official website URL of the place.

contents.name: phone
contents.description: Phone in international format, e.g. '+81 136-21-1234'.

contents.name: openingHours
contents.description: Weekday opening-hours lines, e.g. 'Monday: 09:00–17:00'.

contents.name: types
contents.description: Place types, e.g. ['ski_resort', 'lodging', 'restaurant'].

contents.name: wheelchairAccessible
contents.description: Whether the place is wheelchair accessible.

contents.name: rating
contents.description: Google rating snapshot — NOT stored long-term. The read path strips it once the trip's `updated` is older than 30 days (≤30-day retention, #15 rule).

contents.name: summary
contents.description: Editorial summary of the place (markdown OK). The agent's own content — never Google review/summary text.

contents.name: photo
contents.description: Rights-clean stored photo for the place card — bare media filename (served at /media/<trip_id>/<file> via the Garage S3 pipeline) or an external image URL. NEVER a Google photo: Google-derived imagery is fetched live through /api/places/photo and never stored (#15/#95 compliance).

contents.name: photoCredit
contents.description: Credit line for the stored photo, e.g. 'Photo: Rusutsu Resort' — rendered under the image.

contents.name: photoLicense
contents.description: License of the stored photo, e.g. 'CC BY-SA 4.0' or '© resort press kit (used with permission)'.

contents.name: photoSourceUrl
contents.description: Source page URL of the stored photo (where it came from) — lets the crew later upload their own photos while keeping provenance.

description: A place on the trip — the source for loop markers AND future map

contents.name: name
contents.description: Person's name (placeholder crew or real).

contents.name: contact
contents.description: Phone/email when available.

description: Base identity (placeholder crew OR real person). `User` EXTENDS this.

contents.name: slug
contents.description: URL/identity slug, e.g. 'canada-2027'. Repo folder/file name; editable, NOT part of $dtId.

contents.name: title
contents.description: Trip title.

contents.name: subtitle
contents.description: Trip subtitle / tagline.

contents.name: stage
contents.description: Maturity: idea → options → shortlist → planned → booked → live → archive.

contents.name: startDate
contents.description: ISO start date.

contents.name: endDate
contents.description: ISO end date.

contents.name: timezone
contents.description: IANA timezone, e.g. 'Asia/Tokyo' — resolves 'today' in the trip's local calendar date, not the viewer's. Optional; when absent, the viewer's local date is used.

contents.name: visibility
contents.description: Who may read the trip: 'public' = anyone with the id link (no auth); 'private' = crew only (JWT + hasCrew edge, follower+). Default private (issue #64 — replaces the old token-as-switch).

contents.name: claimToken
contents.description: Secret CLAIM key (issue #6 + #65) — authorizes claiming a crew identity or following this trip ('join link'). Separate from the read path: the read link is the trip id itself (gated by visibility). Editable (rotate without re-wiring the graph). None = no invite links issued.

contents.name: cover
contents.description: Cover image — bare media filename (content-addressed sha256[:32].ext), served at /media/<trip_id>/<file>.

contents.name: coverCredit
contents.description: Cover image credit line.

contents.name: map
contents.description: Overview route-map image — bare media filename, served at /media/<trip_id>/<file>.

contents.name: summary
contents.description: Trip summary (markdown).

contents.name: theme
contents.description: UI theme (colors + font).

contents.name: coverStats
contents.description: Cover strip lines, e.g. '16 DAYS · FEB 15 – MAR 2'.

contents.name: atLocation
contents.description: Links this Trip to its Location twin(s) (from `locations`).

contents.name: stats
contents.description: 'At a glance' stat rows.

contents.name: hasFeature
contents.description: Links this Trip to its Feature twin(s) (from `features`).

contents.name: hasSection
contents.description: Links this Trip to its TripSection twin(s) (from `sections`).

contents.name: hasCrew
contents.description: Links this Trip to its Person twin(s) (from `crew`).

properties.name: role
properties.description: Trip-relative role of the crew member (e.g. owner | planner | guest). Carried on the edge, not on the person.

properties.name: note
properties.description: Trip-relative note about the crew member on this trip (e.g. gear). Carried on the edge, not on the person — the Person/User node is shared across trips after claim.

contents.name: practical
contents.description: Trip-wide practical info.

contents.name: hasDay
contents.description: Links this Trip to its Day twin(s) (from `days`).

contents.name: updated
contents.description: ISO date of last content update.

description: The trip document — the P0 source of truth, and (in P1) the Konnektr Graph

contents.name: title
contents.description: Heading, e.g. 'Days 6–9 — the heli block'.

contents.name: days
contents.description: Inclusive [first,last] 0-based day indices this section groups. Empty during pure ideation. Becomes hasDay edges in the graph.

contents.name: locationRefs
contents.description: Location name/alias(es) this section covers (resolves to Location twins). Multi-place sections allowed.

contents.name: hasBlock
contents.description: Links this TripSection to its Block twin(s) (from `blocks`).

contents.name: fold
contents.description: Display-only: consecutive day groups rendered as a single card in the itinerary (day pages + booklet stay per-day). Empty = render every day.

contents.name: hasDay
contents.description: Synthesized by the converter (not a model field) — links this TripSection to its Day twin(s).

contents.name: atLocation
contents.description: Synthesized by the converter (not a model field) — links this TripSection to its Location twin(s).

contents.name: email
contents.description: Primary login email (unique).

contents.name: displayName
contents.description: Name shown in the UI.

contents.name: authProvider
contents.description: Auth origin: password | auth0 | google (P2).

description: Authenticated user (P2). A User EXTENDS Person — same identity, plus auth.
